name: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis — FRED API (series observations)
access: HTTPS GET to api.stlouisfed.org/fred/series/observations?series_id=&api_key=&file_type=json; the owner's free key is read from <UNKNOWN_HOME>/secrets/fred_api_key (outside git). Inactive without that file.
cost_model: Free of charge with a registered key

rate_limit.source: The terms reserve the right to impose limits (terms of use, read 2026-10-23). Self-imposed: one request per second.

requires_local_config: <UNKNOWN_HOME>/secrets/fred_api_key (one line: the owner's FRED API key)
failure_behavior: No key file: the adapter reports INACTIVE with the file name and makes no request. 429/5xx: bounded backoff, then the run fails. The key is never written to logs, raw-request records or error messages (redacted). '.' observations are stored as NOT_REPORTED, never zero.

datasets.description: Owner-selected FRED series (default DFEDTARU, DFEDTARL, CPIAUCSL, UNRATE, A191RL1Q225SBEA), values as published
datasets.availability_rule: Current vintage only (ALFRED vintages not used): available from first-seen receipt time (flag available_from_first_capture); a changed value is a new publication flagged revised_after_first_seen.
datasets.rights_source: FRED API terms of use (read 2026-10-23): use only as permitted; series may be owned by third parties and need permission for anything other than personal use; applications must show 'This product uses the FRED(R) API but is not endorsed or certified by the Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis.'; on termination stored data must be destroyed. Verdict: allowed for the owner's personal research use with the notice; no redistribution; cloud-model processing withheld.
datasets.rights_status: verified 2026-10-23; inactive until the owner adds a key
